descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As an Inte rn – Access and Policy based in Dhaka , you will play a vital role in supporting Roche Bangladesh Limited’s mission to shape the healthcare ecosystem. You will assist in building strategic partnerships and navigating policy frameworks to ensure our innovative solutions reac h the patients who need them most—helping to unlock possibilities that deliver value for both the healthcare system and society. The Opportunity
• You assist in coordinating partnerships and engagements with Development Organizations, Patient Advocacy Groups (PAGs), Societies, and Foundations to support access and policy initiatives.
• You support the team in developing and maintaining strategic partnerships within government and industry to effectively communicate Roche’s positions.
• You contribute to identifying, mapping, and managing key ecosystem stakeholders to ensure alignment with our corporate strategies.
• You act as a facilitator for collaboration between external stakeholders and internal Roche teams, helping the department serve as a trusted partner.
• You assist in broadening the company's corporate and non-governmental network through market analysis, stakeholder mapping, and outreach support.
• You execute day-to-day departmental operations and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to build trusted internal and external partnerships.
• You commit to a minimum 6-month internship duration, allowing you to gain deep, hands-on experience and make a meaningful impact within the Access and Policy functions. Who You Are
• You are a fresh graduate , or a current student pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Public Health, Public Policy, Business Administration, Pharmacy, or a related field.
• You are a proactive individual with a genuine passion for pursuing a career in Healthcare Policy, Access, or Public Affairs.
• You possess excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and are confident in engaging with diverse stakeholders.
• You have basic IT skills and a strong proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
• You demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a high level of attention to detail.
• You are available to work fully on-site at the office every day and are comfortable working in a structured, fast-paced environment.
• You uphold high ethical standards, maintain confidentiality, and thrive in a collaborative teamwork setting. Why Join Us? At Roche, we endeavor to provide a meaningful and enriching experience that ensures our interns gain valuable industry insights, hands-on knowledge, and the opportunity to build a solid foundation for a career in Access and Policy. What we offer Roche offers rewarding growth opportunities, a competitive remuneration package and a collaborative culture where people are united in purpose and will stretch you to be brave, speak up and think differently. Feel empowered to deliver meaningful outcomes, supported by accessible and inspiring leaders. Roche encourages a high-performance culture where you are empowered and trusted to make decisions.
